onboarding.yaml:
apiVersion: choregos/v1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: onboarding
  version: 1
  description: A joiner — access plan, account and groups ten days before, laptop seven days before, badge handed over, check the day after.
  inputs:
    type: object
    required: [full_name, upn, start_date, job, group, sensitive_group, address]
    properties:
      full_name: { type: string, title: Full name }
      upn: { type: string, title: Sign-in name (UPN) }
      start_date: { type: string, format: date, title: Start date }
      job: { type: string, title: Job title }
      group: { type: string, title: Access group of the role }
      sensitive_group: { type: string, title: Sensitive group (stronger approval) }
      address: { type: string, title: Laptop delivery address }
      model: { type: string, title: Laptop model, default: laptop-14 }
      badge_uid: { type: string, title: Badge UID }
initial: requested
actors:
  coordinator: { type: agent, role: coordination, agent: onboarding-coordinator, max_turns: 40, max_minutes: 20 }
  hr: { type: human, group: hr, sla_hours: 24 }
  reception: { type: human, group: reception, sla_hours: 8 }
  platform: { type: system }
states:
  requested: { display: Request received, kind: wait }
  planned: { display: Access plan proposed, kind: wait }
  approved: { display: Plan approved, kind: wait }
  accounts_created: { display: Account and group created, kind: wait }
  sensitive_granted: { display: Sensitive group decided, kind: wait }
  laptop_shipped: { display: "Laptop ordered, enrolled, shipped", kind: wait }
  badge_issued: { display: Badge handed over, kind: wait }
  active: { display: Badge active, kind: wait }
  needs_review: { display: To review, kind: wait }
  ready: { display: Joiner ready, terminal: true }
transitions:
  - id: t-plan
    from: requested
    to: planned
    by: coordinator
    outputs: [access_plan]
    gates: [outputs_present]
    on_fail: { to: requested, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: needs_review }

  - id: t-approve
    from: planned
    to: approved
    by: hr
    on_reject: needs_review

  - id: t-create-accounts
    from: approved
    to: accounts_created
    by: platform
    action:
      kind: onboarding.accounts
      title: "Account and group of {{ fields.full_name }}"
      justification: "starts on {{ fields.start_date }} as {{ fields.job }}"
      params: { upn: "{{ fields.upn }}", full_name: "{{ fields.full_name }}", group: "{{ fields.group }}" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: directory
            operation: create_user
            arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", display_name: "{{ params.full_name }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with: { connector: directory, operation: disable_user, arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: directory
            operation: add_to_group
            arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", group_id: "{{ params.group }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with:
              connector: directory
              operation: remove_from_group
              arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", group_id: "{{ params.group }}" }
      not_before: fields.start_date - 10d
    on_fail: { to: approved, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: needs_review }

  - id: t-grant-sensitive
    from: accounts_created
    to: sensitive_granted
    by: platform
    action:
      kind: onboarding.sensitive_group
      title: "{{ fields.full_name }} in {{ fields.sensitive_group }}"
      params: { upn: "{{ fields.upn }}", group: "{{ fields.sensitive_group }}" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: directory
            operation: add_to_group
            arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", group_id: "{{ params.group }}" }
      approval:
        approvers: [{ role: project_owner, min: 1 }]
        step_up_minutes: 5
    on_fail: { to: accounts_created, max_attempts: 1, escalate_to: needs_review }
    on_reject: sensitive_granted

  - id: t-ship-laptop
    from: sensitive_granted
    to: laptop_shipped
    by: platform
    action:
      kind: onboarding.laptop
      title: "Laptop of {{ fields.full_name }} ({{ fields.model | default('laptop-14') }})"
      params:
        reference: "{{ work_item.key }}"
        upn: "{{ fields.upn }}"
        model: "{{ fields.model | default('laptop-14') }}"
        address: "{{ fields.address }}"
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: supplier
            operation: order_laptop
            arguments: { reference: "{{ params.reference }}", model: "{{ params.model }}", upn: "{{ params.upn }}" }
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: devices
            operation: enroll_device
            arguments: { serial: "{{ effects[0].serial }}", upn: "{{ params.upn }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with: { connector: devices, operation: wipe_device, arguments: { serial: "{{ result.serial }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: carrier
            operation: create_shipment
            arguments:
              reference: "{{ params.reference }}-laptop"
              address: "{{ params.address }}"
              items: ["{{ effects[0].serial }}"]
      not_before: fields.start_date - 7d
    on_fail: { to: sensitive_granted, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: needs_review }

  - id: t-hand-over-badge
    from: laptop_shipped
    to: badge_issued
    by: reception
    task:
      title: Hand over the badge
      instructions: Hand the badge to its holder in person, then hold it to the reader to read its UID.
      form:
        type: object
        required: [badge_uid]
        properties:
          badge_uid: { type: string, title: Badge UID, minLength: 8 }
      attest: I handed the badge to its holder in person
    on_reject: needs_review

  - id: t-activate-badge
    from: badge_issued
    to: active
    by: platform
    action:
      kind: onboarding.badge
      title: "Activate badge {{ fields.badge_uid }}"
      params: { uid: "{{ fields.badge_uid }}", holder: "{{ fields.upn }}" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: badge-readers
            operation: activate_badge
            arguments: { uid: "{{ params.uid }}", holder: "{{ params.holder }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with: { connector: badge-readers, operation: deactivate_badge, arguments: { uid: "{{ params.uid }}" } }
    on_fail: { to: badge_issued, max_attempts: 1, escalate_to: needs_review }

  - id: t-check
    from: active
    to: ready
    by: platform
    action:
      kind: onboarding.check
      title: "Check the onboarding of {{ fields.full_name }}"
      params: { upn: "{{ fields.upn }}", uid: "{{ fields.badge_uid }}", reference: "{{ work_item.key }}-laptop" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with: { connector: directory, operation: get_user, arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with: { connector: badge-readers, operation: badge_status, arguments: { uid: "{{ params.uid }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with: { connector: carrier, operation: shipment_status, arguments: { reference: "{{ params.reference }}" } }
        - effect: check
          with:
            condition: "{{ effects[0].user is not none and effects[1].active and effects[2].state != 'unknown' }}"
            reason: the account, the active badge and the laptop shipment
      not_before: fields.start_date + 1d
    on_fail: { to: active, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: needs_review }

metadata.name: onboarding
metadata.description: A joiner — access plan, account and groups ten days before, laptop seven days before, badge handed over, check the day after.

badge_task.title: Hand over the badge
badge_task.instructions: Hand the badge to its holder in person, then hold it to the reader to read its UID.
badge_task.attest: I handed the badge to its holder in person
